description: One published event: description, ticket types with prices and whether each is sold out, what the registration form asks, and how people get in (entry.url and Spanish entry.instructions to relay).

slug.description: The event slug, from search-events or the event URL (/e/{slug}).

name: get-event

description.description: Full description as the organizer wrote it; may contain HTML.

ended.description: True when the event is over.

instructions.description: How to get in, in Spanish. Relay it to the person.

methods.description: Ways to pay that are open now: card, transfer. Empty for free registration.

mode.description: free (register at no cost), paid (buy a ticket) or closed (the organizer has not opened entry yet).

open.description: Whether people can register or buy right now.

paused.description: True when the organizer paused sales for now.

url.description: Where the person starts: checkout for an open paid event, otherwise the event page.

image.description: Image to show with the event.

organizer.description: Who runs the event. Null when the organizer has no public profile.

presale.description: Followers-only presale that is open now, else null.

ends_at.description: When the presale ends, ISO 8601 with offset.

follow_unlocks.description: True when following the organizer now gives access.

instructions.description: Presale rule in Spanish. Relay it to the person.

ticket_type_ids.description: Ticket types held for followers until then.

price_from.description: Lowest price now; 0.00 for free registration. Null when entry is closed.

amount.description: Decimal amount with two places, e.g. "150.00".

questions.description: What the registration or checkout form asks each attendee.

kind.description: Answer type: text, long_text, number, phone, date, choice or yes_no.

label.description: The question as the attendee reads it.

options.description: Answers to pick from, for kind choice.

remaining.description: Places left. Present only when the organizer shows it.

slug.description: Identifies the event in get-event and get-checkout-link.

summary.description: First 200 characters of the description, plain text. Null when the event has none.

theme_tone.description: Tone the organizer chose: auto, light or dark.

ticket_types.description: Paid categories. Empty for free registration.

checkout_url.description: Checkout with this category and one ticket chosen. Null when it cannot be bought now.

presale_only.description: Present and true while only followers can buy it.

amount.description: Decimal amount with two places, e.g. "150.00".

price_phase.description: Name of the price phase in effect, e.g. "Preventa". Null at base price.

timezone.description: IANA timezone of the event, e.g. America/Guatemala.

title_font.description: Title font of the event page.

tone.description: Light or dark, as the page renders.

title: Get Event
